description: Source code for the SalesPerson doctype in ERPNext, defining the SalesPerson class with validation, dashboard info loading, email retrieval, and timeline data functions.

classes.name: SalesPerson
classes.description: Represents a sales person with validation, dashboard info, email retrieval, and hierarchy validation.

methods.description: Validates the sales person's hierarchy and targets.
